Similarly, in terms of tokens usage, which directly impact the runtime of the approach, Magistral-Small-2509 generated the longest thoughts on average, with similar values for the other models. In addition, these numbers of thought tokens also vary based on the setting and domain. Using the token length insights on ZESHEL, as well as those from Section E , we also report the results for a runtime-optimized configuration on ZESHEL by sampling only three answers for self-consistency and by limiting the context length to 8192 tokens. The results show that these two settings effectively result in significant runtime improvements across the three models, but at the expense of some accuracy percentage points. The results show that BM25 underperforms compared to the three other approaches, while Qwen3-Reranker-4B achieves the highest recall@10 and Qwen3-Embedding-4B yield competitive results, despite the latter not being provided with the context.
